summary: Add Postgres to a Next.js app through Drizzle ORM, with checked-in SQL migrations and a private database for each test file.
description: Add PostgreSQL to the Next.js stack through Drizzle ORM and the pg driver: Docker Compose services for development and tests, checked-in SQL migrations with a drift check, a server-only database module, one repository behind the starter items service and a readiness route. Each test file gets its own database cloned from a migrated template, and the end-to-end run gets its own too. Your product tables, queries and access rules are still to write; hosting a production database is separate.
seoDescription: Postgres for Next.js through Drizzle ORM and pg, with Docker Compose, checked-in SQL migrations and isolated databases for each test file.
